Body.Content:
The June 2020 update for the Azure SDKs is now available.

The following SDKs have been updated and are ready for production:

  • Cosmos DB (Java)
  • Event Hubs
  • Azure Storage
  • Text Analytics

Additionally, the following modules are now available in preview:

  • Azure.Identity
  • Azure Search
  • Form Recognizer
  • Service Bus

There’s also a new Azure SDK for C Embedded available, which is optimized for small embedded devices with limited capabilities and resources.

Read the announcement
